hook: Foaming photopolymers enable 20,000 dpi inkless printing
what_happened: Researchers used UV‑A light to trigger foaming in a polymer film, creating controlled pores and a white, high‑resolution pattern
why_it_matters: It removes the need for ink and allows sub‑micron printing of optical and mechanical features
the_catch: The method relies on a weak solvent and has not been tested beyond the laboratory scale
caption: New foam‑based photolithography prints at 20,000 dpi without ink – a step toward bio‑inspired, high‑resolution manufacturing
alt_text: A five‑slide carousel explaining how UV‑induced foaming in photopolymers creates high‑resolution, inkless printing, highlighting the process, benefits, and limitations

es.hook: Los fotopolímeros espumosos permiten impresión sin tinta a 20 000 dpi
es.what_happened: Los investigadores emplearon luz UV‑A para provocar la espuma en una película de polímero, creando poros controlados y un patrón blanco de alta resolución
es.why_it_matters: Elimina la necesidad de tinta y permite la impresión submicrométrica de características ópticas y mecánicas
es.the_catch: El método depende de un disolvente débil y no se ha probado más allá de la escala de laboratorio
